doc: Task 11c: agents-job-memory is the the container memory limit; a job that fills its tmpfs past it is killed by the kernel (exit 137).

args: set -e; podman pull -q docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 >/dev/null; d=$(podman image inspect --format '{{.Digest}}' docker.io/library/busybox:1.36); mkdir -p $ROOT/work;  printf '(drgnx-settings :version 1 (drgnx-agents-container-images (("busybox" . "docker.io/library/busybox@%s"))) (drgnx-agents-job-memory "64M"))\n' "$d" > $CONFIG/settings.el; chmod 600 $CONFIG/settings.el

argv: dd if=/dev/zero of=/tmp/fill bs=1M count=512 2>/dev/null; echo survived
